name: A Donation of Wool
summary: In Darnassus, wool cloth is gathered to support the city's stores. Your sixty pieces earn recognition for your generosity.

sections.title: Wool Stores
sections.body: Darnassus needs sixty pieces of wool cloth from you. Others across the realm are expected to provide the rest of its stores. Your donation earns full recognition for your generosity.

faq.answer: Darnassus needs wool cloth to support its stores.

faq.q: How much wool do I need to donate?
faq.answer: You need to donate sixty pieces of wool cloth.
Darnassus is gathering wool cloth to support its stores.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: Your donation of sixty pieces earns full recognition from Darnassus for your generosity.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Wool
